summary: Avoid PRs that don't merge cleanly unless you know Git, check that devel-based PRs have one commit, and source hacking/env-setup to run Ansible from source for the shell session.
questions: How do I run Ansible from a source checkout without installing it?

answer_card.title: Running Ansible from source
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell-session
source ./hacking/env-setup
```
It sets `PYTHONPATH` and other variables for the current shell session. If the PR doesn't merge cleanly, resolving conflicts is the author's job. For `someuser:devel` PRs, check there's only one commit.
